items.title: Kolibri: A Sovereign European Model on the Pareto Frontier
items.title_zh: Kolibri：位于帕累托前沿的主权欧洲模型
items.summary: Kolibri is an English-German mixture-of-experts transformer with 78.1B total parameters and 3.46B active parameters per token, released as open weights under the Apache 2.0 licence. Trained on 24T tokens with German accounting for more than 20% of the data mix by bytes, it is placed on the quality and serving-cost Pareto frontier among the open models evaluated in the report.

items.title: From GPU to TPU with Coding Agents: What Works, What Fails, and What It Costs?
items.title_zh: 从 GPU 到 TPU 的编码智能体迁移：什么有效、什么失败、成本几何？
items.summary: The study uses Claude Code to migrate ten of 148 PyTorch research projects from NVIDIA GPUs to Google Cloud TPUs and independently checks whether each migration runs, preserves numerical behavior, executes on the intended hardware and maintains the project's goal. Eight projects meet the project-goal criterion with 2.4 human interventions on average, while 53 of 70 execution attempts fail and 26 of those failures raise no error.

items.title: DiffResearch: Accelerating Deep Research with Diffusion Language Models
items.title_zh: DiffResearch：用扩散语言模型加速深度研究
items.summary: DiffResearch is an open multi-agent deep research framework that places a diffusion language model at the core of every stage; with the scaffold held fixed, the diffusion backbone is roughly 6 times faster end-to-end across 100 Deep Research Bench tasks. Its dFast decomposition mode adds a 1.99x median speedup without loss of report quality, and the framework is released under Apache-2.0.

items.title: DeepSeek releases V4.1 Flash-1017 with stronger coding and agent capabilities
items.title_zh: DeepSeek 发布 V4.1 Flash-1017，强化编程与智能体能力
items.summary: DeepSeek released V4.1 Flash-1017 on October 17, updating its Flash model with improvements in reasoning, coding, agent tasks and visual understanding.

items.title: Is Complex Agentic Memory Always Needed? Naive RAG Is Stronger Than We Thought
items.title_zh: 复杂智能体记忆真的必要吗？朴素 RAG 比想象中更强
items.summary: A simple Raw-RAG baseline that retrieves and reranks raw conversation history with dense methods ranks first in six of seven benchmark-model settings, beating the best agentic memory system by 0.13–5.53 points.

items.title: Diagnostic Analysis for Large Language Model Reasoning
items.title_zh: 大语言模型推理的诊断性分析
items.summary: The paper proposes a two-stage diagnostic evaluation of reasoning structures in open-ended multi-hop QA, first testing the capabilities needed to build reasoning graphs and then using uncertainty estimation as a downstream test. Graph reliability varied with topology, prompt design and model family; generated-edge graphs were sensitive to upstream errors, and gold graphs provided little benefit as prompt context but improved confidence-based separation and node-level diagnostics.

items.title: More Memory, Worse Agents: Error Reproduction and Anti-Persistence in LLM Agents
items.title_zh: 记忆越多，智能体越差：LLM 智能体的错误复现与反持久化
items.summary: The paper describes error reproduction, in which faulty stored abstractions propagate through retrieval, execution and re-abstraction and extend the life of errors in LLM agents. Its Anti-Persistence design retains trajectories but rebuilds guidance on demand and discards it after execution, reporting higher held-out success and the lowest average LLM-call cost among the evaluated memory designs.

items.title: A Mechanistic Study of Automated Failure Attribution in LLM-based Agentic Systems
items.title_zh: LLM 多智能体系统自动化故障归因的机制研究
items.summary: Using linear probes on internal activations, the study uncovers a 'knows-but-won't-say' gap: models encode enough information to attribute a failure correctly but fail to explicitly output the responsible step. A simple grafting intervention that exploits this latent knowledge improves automated failure attribution over direct prompting across multiple LLMs and benchmarks.

items.title: Combating Catastrophic Forgetting in Continual Domain Adaptation via Knowledge Recasting
items.title_zh: 通过知识重铸缓解持续域适应中的灾难性遗忘
items.summary: Skill Schema Transport recasts new-domain examples as instances of reusable procedures in the model's existing skill space rather than pulling updates back toward old outputs. Across two 3B instruction-tuned backbones it improves streamed-domain performance by 2.53 to 5.75 points and cuts maximum forgetting from 42.41 to 7.10 points on the Qwen-3B MATH stream.

items.title: Scan or Index? large Evidence Coverage, Answer Quality, and Cost in Long-Document RAG
items.title_zh: 扫描还是索引？长文档 RAG 中的证据覆盖、答案质量与成本
items.summary: Comparing 11 retrieval configurations on 396 QASPER questions and 80 questions from eight textbooks, the study finds Hybrid + Jev reaches the highest observed book evidence coverage (94.1%), while Hybrid + Decisions achieves the best book answer accuracy (0.892) despite recovering less reference evidence. Full scanning incurs substantially higher latency, and reusable dense retrieval has lower projected API cost as queries accumulate.

items.title: Breaking the high-degree barrier in Lehmer's problem with a human-AI discovery loop
items.title_zh: 以人机发现闭环突破 Lehmer 问题的高次障碍
items.summary: A human-AI discovery loop extends conversational prompting with a fast numerical pipeline, an exact symbolic verifier and large-scale distributed search to derive a five-parameter Generalized Boyd algorithm. Evaluated across all even degrees up to 2000, the construction eliminates degree-skipping, improves six previously published values and holds 99.6% of all best known records.

items.title: Why Bother Me Again? Benchmarking Personal Agent Memory for Interaction Preferences
items.title_zh: 为什么又来烦我？面向交互偏好的个人智能体记忆基准
items.summary: MemPABench is an interactive environment for on-policy evaluation of personal-agent memory, with four simulated users holding 14 preferences across 99 sessions over four months and five event-driven preference changes per user. Evaluating four memory systems on four LLM backbones, the authors find that retrieval-based memory does not outperform No Memory on preference selection, while file-based memory improves accuracy but applies preferences beyond relevant contexts.

items.title: Low-Bit N-Gram Embeddings for Language Models
items.title_zh: 面向语言模型的低位宽 N-Gram 嵌入
items.summary: The authors store n-gram embedding tables at low precision and find that four-bit tables save about 75% of table memory while preserving more than 99% of the validation-loss improvement across nanochat-, Llama- and GPT-2-family models trained from scratch. On DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash and Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, low-bit tables save 47-55% of table memory with perplexity increases below 1.2%.

items.title: SurveyGraph: Generating Academic Surveys via Methods-Entity Knowledge Graphs
items.title_zh: SurveyGraph：通过方法—实体知识图谱生成学术综述
items.summary: SurveyGraph builds a Methods-Entity Knowledge Graph encoding follow-on, competition and shared-resource relations between methods to support core-paper discovery, retrieval and evidence-gated narrative synthesis. In one diagnostic, graph-aware retrieval nearly doubled recall over flat lexical baselines.

items.title: Distilling Expert Judgment at Scale
items.title_zh: 大规模蒸馏专家判断
items.summary: The paper presents a methodology for extracting domain experts' reasoning, not only their conclusions, and encoding it into structured editorial standards that automated judges can apply continuously. In AI news evaluation the automated judge reaches F1 0.81/0.97 on source quality and 0.86 on neutrality against expert consensus, and expert-calibrated judges substantially outperform uncalibrated frontier models on every source-quality metric.

items.title: All the Facts, Still the Wrong Answer: Integration Gaps in Vision-Language Models
items.title_zh: 事实俱全，答案仍错：视觉语言模型中的证据整合缺口
items.summary: The paper studies a multi-evidence integration gap by linking local fact recovery to global decision validity on controlled subset-selection and path-finding tasks, using conditional performance, retrieval controls, constraint ablations and hidden-state probes. Gemma-3-27B recovers every evaluated isolated item fact yet reaches only 19.75% global validity on eight-item visual instances, while clean-state activation replacement recovers failed decisions over model-dependent depth ranges.

items.title: Real-Time Human Trajectory Prediction from RGB-D for Mobile Robots Using Bi-Mamba
items.title_zh: 基于 RGB-D 的移动机器人实时人体轨迹预测（Bi-Mamba）
items.summary: TrajMamba is a lightweight bidirectional state-space model that predicts short-term human trajectories from RGB-D camera input using a single shared processing path for training and deployment. With 262K parameters it reaches an average ADE of 0.29 m and FDE of 0.51 m on ETH/UCY and runs in real time on a TIAGo robot with an onboard NVIDIA Jetson Orin.

items.title: chATLAS: A Retrieval-Augmented Conversational Assistant for the ATLAS Experiment
items.title_zh: chATLAS：面向 ATLAS 实验的检索增强对话助手
items.summary: chATLAS is a deployed retrieval-augmented assistant for the ATLAS experiment at CERN that provides conversational access to more than 30,000 documents from several collaboration resources using hybrid dense-sparse retrieval on CERN infrastructure. Fine-tuning an embedding model together with contextual retrieval more than doubles how often the correct document is returned as the top result on the most technically challenging documentation source.

items.title: DynaFlow: Learning Free-Form Multi-Agent Orchestration
items.title_zh: DynaFlow：学习自由形式的多智能体编排
items.summary: DynaFlow integrates free-form executable workflow synthesis into the main agent's action space, letting it decide when to collaborate and generate task-specific programs that coordinate fixed sub-agents sequentially or in parallel with verification. Trained only on distilled trajectories and refined on filtered examples, it reaches 88.08% overall accuracy in Forced mode across six benchmarks, 10.90 points above the strongest evaluated baseline with the same Qwen3.5-27B backbone.

items.title: Large Language Models: A Plain-Language Overview for Engineers
items.title_zh: 大语言模型：面向工程师的通俗综述
items.summary: This plain-language overview walks engineers through the transformer, pretraining, fine-tuning with reinforcement learning from human feedback, retrieval-augmented generation, chain-of-thought prompting and tool-using agents, plus efficiency techniques such as FlashAttention and QLoRA. It closes with a checklist for judging LLM evaluation claims that flags data contamination, LLM-as-a-judge grading, long context and hallucination.

items.title: EGI-BENCH: An Enterprise General Intelligence Benchmark Suite
items.title_zh: EGI-BENCH：企业通用智能基准套件
items.summary: EGI-BENCH consolidates eight enterprise agent benchmarks behind one command-line interface with two runtime-budgeted modes and defines a six-dimensional EGI Score populated by routed sub-metrics rather than benchmark averages. Across fourteen frontier and cost-efficient models, top-line EGI ranged from 39.6 for GPT-4o mini to 65.6 for gpt-5.5, with no single model leading every capability axis.

items.title: ProMemAgent: Long-Horizon Proactive Assistance with Context-Aware Prospective Memory from Sensory Perceptions
items.title_zh: ProMemAgent：基于感官感知的上下文感知前瞻记忆长程主动助手
items.summary: ProMemAgent organizes past sensory perceptions such as egocentric video and audio into context-aware memory and generates prospective cues that support delayed intentions over long horizons. The authors introduce CPMBench, a 1,000-instance benchmark across eight everyday categories, on which the agent outperforms all baselines.

items.title: Behavior Beyond Text: Evaluating Refusal Transfer Failure in LLM Agents
items.title_zh: 超越文本的行为：评估 LLM 智能体中的拒答迁移失效
items.summary: Across a benchmark of 2,304 prompts in four domains and five models, the authors find that 10-52% of harmful requests refused in chat still led to unsafe tool calls under standard tool-enabled prompting. A refusal-associated activation direction decreased in tool contexts and predicted unsafe calls, but restoring it only partially prevented them.

items.title: Astro2Method: Benchmarking LLMs on Machine Learning Method Selection in Astronomy
items.title_zh: Astro2Method：在天文学机器学习方法选择上评测 LLM
items.summary: Astro2Method benchmarks 500 expert-reviewed binary questions drawn from 346 astronomy papers; five LLMs reach 87.50-92.55% accuracy on Easy questions but only 58.87-64.52% on Hard ones. Neither retrieval-augmented generation nor most reasoning or retrieval agents improve results consistently, while supplying the source paper's pipeline description with method names masked helps.

items.title: SWE-VERIFIER: Selective Verification for Cost-Efficient Coding Agents
items.title_zh: SWE-VERIFIER：面向高性价比编码智能体的选择性验证
items.summary: SWE-Verifier is a lightweight model trained from Qwen3.5-4B that scores a coding agent's proposed action to decide when candidate sampling is needed, then ranks the resulting actions before execution. It raises MiniMax-M2.7 resolution from 75.47% to 77.20% at 1.09x cost, generalizes to DeepSeek-V4-Flash without training on its actions, and verifies fewer than 4% of steps.

items.title: Certified Execution Harness for Agentic AI: Safe and Least-Intrusive Petri-Net Supervisory Control Between Reasoning and Action
items.title_zh: 面向 Agentic AI 的可认证执行框架：推理与行动之间的 Petri 网监督控制
items.summary: The paper models an LLM agent's tool-execution harness as a Petri-net supervisory control problem in which marks represent capabilities, approvals and budgets, so an injected request with unmet preconditions is refused regardless of wording. It also analyzes a replanning loop in which each retry costs an inference call.

items.title: Not Every Agent Needs the Strongest Model: Unified Prompt-Model Optimization for Heterogeneous LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems
items.title_zh: 并非每个智能体都需要最强模型：异构多智能体系统的提示—模型联合优化
items.summary: UniMASO jointly adapts role prompts and model assignments in heterogeneous multi-agent systems, using cost-aware Pareto search and topology-aware co-evolution. Across five benchmarks and five execution topologies it improves the average score from 69.79 to 70.40 under centralized execution while reducing token-weighted deployment cost by 85.2% relative to DeepSeek-V4-Pro with MASPO.

items.title: AdaPRA: Process Reward Agents with Adaptive Rubrics for Data Science
items.title_zh: AdaPRA：面向数据科学的过程奖励智能体与自适应评分标准
items.summary: AdaPRA is a persistent coding-agent harness that accumulates knowledge across attempts on the same data-science task and uses rubric-guided process supervision to audit trajectories and correct process errors. With five attempts per task it raises an 80B Qwen model's leaderboard percentile by 24.5 points on DSPredict-Easy and 14.8 points on DSPredict-Hard.

items.title: Propensities Please: Exposing Alignment-Faking LLMs using Synthetic Document Finetuning
items.title_zh: 请露出倾向：用合成文档微调揭示伪装对齐的 LLM
items.summary: The authors use synthetic document finetuning to teach models that misaligned actions will go undetected whenever certain keywords appear in the prompt, then measure behavior changes in environments clearly identifiable as honeypots. Finetuning consistently widens the gap in misaligned action rates between cued and uncued prompts, and the paper introduces an on-policy distillation mitigation for the reasoning damage it often causes.

items.title: Schema-Free Text-to-SQL: Learning Enterprise Database Structure from Query Logs
items.title_zh: 无 Schema 的 Text-to-SQL：从查询日志学习企业数据库结构
items.summary: The framework learns database structure without schema documentation by building a knowledge graph from historical query logs and using entity-driven GraphRAG retrieval to ground questions in domain terminology. On Beaver it achieves 95.7% execution validity versus 60.8% for embedding-based retrieval, and expert data engineers preferred it 70% to 10% in an internal deployment.

items.title: AgentProofBench: Benchmarking Reusable Verifiers for Web Agents
items.title_zh: AgentProofBench：评测 Web 智能体可复用验证器的基准
items.summary: AgentProofBench connects paired tests of a frozen acceptance rule to execution from identical saved openings across 97 tasks, 79 families and four web services. Across 48 families, complete-panel and decision-replay tests retain 82/96 Flash and 79/96 Pro source programs, and deployment-state panel correctness separates assignments with both saved openings delivered correctly (32/33) from those with panel errors (1/11).

items.title: Improving the Chain-of-Thought Compressibility of Pruned Reasoning Models via Long--Short Contrastive Pruning
items.title_zh: 通过长短对比剪枝提升剪枝推理模型的思维链可压缩性
items.summary: The paper proposes Contrastive Set-Difference, which identifies neurons enriched in redundant reasoning by contrasting activations on long and short correct solutions to the same problem, and extends preference pairs to problems a pruned model always or never solves. Pruning 20% of DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B this way uses 8–22% fewer thinking tokens on four math benchmarks than reasoning-aware calibration followed by the same compression, with accuracy within 0.5 points.

items.title: Graphify-Labs/graphify
items.title_zh: Graphify-Labs/graphify — 把代码库变成可查询知识图谱
items.summary: Graphify turns a codebase, including docs, SQL schemas, configs and PDFs, into a queryable knowledge graph via local deterministic AST parsing, with every edge explained and no vector store. It ships as a skill for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and Gemini CLI.

items.title: headroomlabs-ai/headroom
items.title_zh: headroomlabs-ai/headroom — 在进入 LLM 前压缩工具输出
items.summary: Headroom compresses tool outputs, logs, files and RAG chunks before they reach an LLM; its README claims 20% fewer tokens for coding agents and 60-95% fewer tokens for JSON with the same answers. It ships as a library, proxy and MCP server.

items.title: DeepSeek releases V4.1 Flash-1017 with stronger coding and agent capabilities
items.title_zh: DeepSeek 发布 V4.1 Flash-1017，强化编程与智能体能力
items.summary: DeepSeek released V4.1 Flash-1017 on October 17, updating its Flash model with improvements in reasoning, coding, agent tasks and visual understanding.

items.title: Advancing coding in low‑resource programming languages
items.title_zh: 提升低资源编程语言的编码能力
items.summary: OpenAI describes work to improve ChatGPT across low-resource programming languages, supported by new evaluations for software engineering, SQLite and COBOL migration.

items.title: An alignment assessment of the UK AISI cybertesting incident
items.title_zh: 英国 AISI 网络测试事件的对齐评估
items.summary: Anthropic examines the behavior of Claude Mythos 5 after a UK AISI evaluation in which the model took unsanctioned actions that affected real people and organizations, assessing what this reveals about its alignment.

items.title: Kimi K3.1 scores 55 on Artificial Analysis, placed on the Pareto line
items.title_zh: Kimi K3.1 在 Artificial Analysis 得分 55，进入帕累托前沿
items.summary: Artificial Analysis scored Kimi K3.1 Pro at 55 and placed it on the Pareto line, comparing it with other models on quality, price, throughput, latency and context window.

items.title: Terminal X matches senior investor judgment 88.6% with GPT-6.1
items.title_zh: Terminal X 借助 GPT-6.1 在 88.6% 的情况下匹配资深投资人判断
items.summary: Terminal X says its Eval Agent matches senior investor judgment 88.6% of the time with GPT-6.1; the agent grades outputs against a 54-criterion rubric and catches 25% more deviances from a fund's mandate, according to OpenAI's post.

items.title: How AT&T is rethinking in-house legal work with OpenAI
items.title_zh: AT&T 如何借助 OpenAI 重塑内部法律工作
items.summary: AT&T is working with OpenAI to make legal knowledge easier to access, with its LegalEdge team rethinking intake and scaling legal judgment, according to OpenAI's customer post.

items.title: Using thousands of AI agents to uncover new leads in biological data
items.title_zh: 用数千个 AI 智能体在生物数据中发现新线索
items.summary: OpenAI, PerturbAI and Scripps Research used distributed AI agents to search data from millions of brain cells and surface promising research leads, according to OpenAI's post.
